dog.description_text:
I'm available for adoption at ACC's Mobile Adoption Event on Saturday, September 19 from 12pm - 4pm at the Animal Welfare Caucus, 254 East 4th Street, New York, NY 10009. Adoptions are in-person and first come, first served, so make sure to get there early. You can apply for me now, but it will not put me on hold for you. I can't wait to meet you!

What my friends at ACC say about me:

I will need daily physical activity to keep me healthy and happy!

I am playful and cute!

A Volunteer Wrote: I said, "uh oh," when I saw Winry sitting curled up in her kennel, gazing with one blue eye and one brown at me standing there while she wagged her tail; uh oh, because there went my heart. That's the effect Winry has on everyone. She is a little bit shy, but that just means she wants to get all the closer to be pet, showing her happiness with that ever-present wagging tail. She walks gently, she takes treats gently, she exists in life as a gentle spirit. Please consider sharing your home and your love with this so-deserving girl!

Where can you find me?

I am at the Manhattan Animal Care Center location.
You can contact me by

Phone 212-788-4000
Address 326 East 110th Street
New York NY 10029

We unfortunately can not put animals on HOLD over the phone

Dear Customer, please understand to prevent disappointment, this website is live and updates frequently, there is chance that when you would arrive at our location the animal you have an interest in might have been adopted or another party might be going through the adoption process at that present time
dog.name: Winry
